turns.content: An equimolar 7.20 g sample of two ammonium salts is decomposed. Convert the gas-train observations into moles: 3.60 g retained by Mg(ClO4)2, 0.80 g oxygen gained by hot copper, and 2.24 L residual gas at STP.
Interpret what each stage removes or transforms, and write a gas ledger for water, an oxygen-donating gas, and the residual gas.
Use the gas ledger to propose an equimolar pair of substances consistent with the observed transformations. Let the amount of each substance be x and solve for x.
Check the proposed pair against the initial sample mass and all three gas-train observations.
Count the atoms in the chemical formula of each supported candidate and add the two counts.
State the idealizations behind the identification and the evidential status currently warranted by the indirect gas-train data.
Verify mass and elemental balance for the proposed decomposition reactions and gas-train operations.
Report the proposed pair and combined atom count, together with the appropriate qualification from the indirect gas-train evidence.
